newsitem.title: JAPAN: Private institutions likely to buy stocks--Amnuay.
newsitem.headline: Private institutions likely to buy stocks--Amnuay.

text.p: Private institutions such as banks are likely to buy Thai stocks because it would be in their interest and carry little outside risk, Thailand's Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan told reporters in Tokyo on Thursday.
Asked if there was anything he would like to say to reassure the Thai stock market, Amnuay said that financial institutions were likely "to intervene" in the bourse.
He added that such moves would be "to their interests...with no outside risk".
"We will support them," he said, adding that it would mean that public funds would not be required.
